text: @highlight We are a family of three. Both my spouse and I work in the care sector, serving and supporting people in our community. Unfortunately, when we applied for our visas, my visa and my child's visa were refused. Our child is about to start school, and this situation has caused us immense stress and uncertainty. Our only wish is to stay together as a family. We do not want to be separated because of this decision. Keeping our family united is essential for our child's well-being, education, and emotional development. We humbly ask for your kindness, support, and understanding. Please support our petition and help us keep our family together. Your support means more to us than words can express. Thank you for taking the time to read our story and for standing with our family.
comment_summary: Shares a personal account of visa refusal affecting the commenter's family unit, emphasizing the emotional and practical hardship of potential family separation while their child begins school. Requests community support for the petition to change UK policy on care worker dependant sponsorship.
post_text: Petition: End the ban of care workers bringing dependants to the UK End the ban on care workers being able to bring their dependants to the UK. Allow them to sponsor spouses, children, or other dependants, even if their sponsorship is issued after 11 March 2024. https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775310 We ask the UK Government to allow care workers already living and working in the UK to be able to sponsor their dependants, including those who are already in the UK. We believe the Government should allow them because if they agree to support and contribute to care services, it could help NHS and Care sector. We request an end to this ban to prevent family separation, as well as ensure fairness and stability for care workers who support the UK care sector.
